title: Unique Buttery Thai Noodles Pad See Ew
description: A buttery and tender Thai dish featuring barbeque sauce and a rich deglaze fond, perfect for a brunch mood, this pad see ew recipe is egg free friendly.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions until they are tender.
In a small bowl, whisk together the barbeque sauce, soy sauce, and oyster sauce.
In a large skillet or wok, heat the vegetable oil over medium high heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the Chinese broccoli and cook until it starts to soften, about 2 minutes.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and stir to combine with the garlic and broccoli.
Pour the barbeque sauce mixture into the skillet and stir to coat the noodles.
Add the unsalted butter to the skillet and stir until it is melted and the noodles are well coated.
Use a spatula to deglaze the fond from the bottom of the skillet and stir it into the noodles.
Season with salt to taste and serve immediately.
